description: Dreamer's Travelling Show rolls from town to town on the old trade roads: a dozen acts nobody else wants, two horses who hate everyone, and a rival circus that plays dirty. Built on camera, one episode at a time.
advancedDescription:
# Dreamer's Travelling Show

A circus caravan of painted wagons rolling down the old trade roads, a dozen acts who aren't wanted anywhere else, a cook who swears the stew is chicken, two horses who hate everyone, and me, the ringmaster, grin a bit too wide, never once seen asleep.

**What you get**
- Pick an act and travel with the show from town to town
- Knife throwing, sleight of hand and animal handling, rolled for real
- The Gilt Circus on the same roads, and they don't play fair

**How it was made**
This is the Workshop world from my Voyage guide videos. Every part of it was built on camera, one episode at a time, so if you want to know how something works, there's a video for it.
